issues.legal_issue: An interim direction made in a contempt proceeding that is later dismissed as withdrawn does not remain independently operative as a basis for review.
material_facts: The High Court had directed the municipal authority to decide whether public land had been encroached upon and to take lawful action if it found an encroachment; it had made no finding that an encroachment existed or directed its removal.
During a later contempt proceeding, the High Court granted one month to comply with its earlier order.
The contempt proceeding was subsequently dismissed as withdrawn at the petitioner’s request, with liberty to file a fresh contempt petition if necessary.
The municipal authority later sought review of the interim compliance order made in the contempt proceeding.
issues.conclusion: The interim order ceased to operate when the contempt proceeding was dismissed as withdrawn, so it had no independent existence and there was no occasion to review it.
issues.legal_principle: Interim orders merge into the final order in the proceeding and cannot survive independently after that proceeding is dismissed. The Court applied this principle to the contempt proceeding and its withdrawal. No earlier cases or statutory provisions were relied on for this ruling; the review petition had invoked Article 226 of the Constitution and the High Court Rules.

rule.if: proceeding_is_contempt_case and prior_interim_compliance_order and contempt_case_dismissed_as_withdrawn and review_challenges_prior_interim_order

predicates.proceeding_is_contempt_case: The proceeding in which the interim order was made was a contempt proceeding.
predicates.prior_interim_compliance_order: The court had made an interim order requiring compliance with an earlier direction.
predicates.contempt_case_dismissed_as_withdrawn: The contempt proceeding was later dismissed as withdrawn.
predicates.review_challenges_prior_interim_order: A party sought review of the interim order after the contempt proceeding had been dismissed.

issues.definition: When a contempt proceeding containing an interim compliance order is dismissed as withdrawn and review is sought against that order, the order has no independent existence to support review.
